status: ADAPT (MEG part of Hunold et al. 2016 on the MNE sample subject); OPM columns are a NEW extension

sensors.system: Neuromag Vectorview geometry of the MNE sample recording
sensors.coil_types: T3 (3014 gradiometer, 3024 magnetometer) with MNE's 4-point 'normal' rule (study coils 9014/9024)

descriptors.depth: distance to the nearest node of the 5120-triangle scalp BEM mesh
descriptors.orientation: angle to the normal of the nearest node of the 5120-triangle inner-skull mesh, folded 0-90 deg

sources.sampling: stratified to the paper's per-bin counts (Fig. 3c; 3783 dipoles)

waveform.construction: PCHIP through the digitised Fig. 2b points, peak 600 nAm at 24 ms

snr.channel: largest noise-free spike amplitude, per sensor type
snr.background_amplitude: mean(+|hilbert|) - mean(-|hilbert|) = 2 mean|hilbert|; analytic signal of the whole trace, cropped

numerators.basis: Fig. 6 digitisation (scripts/digitise_hunold_fig6.py, 8 MEG traces with printed SNR > 2.4): p2p / (2 mean|hilbert|) = 0.87-1.10 x printed depending on digitisation handling; literal noisy peak 0.61-0.73 x

bins.rule: a patch bin with fewer patches is left blank in the maps, comparisons and tests (counts kept)

extension_intrinsic_noise.description: 0.5-70 Hz zero-phase Butterworth (order 4) on spike, background and white sensor noise; SQUID brochure noise; OPM 7/15/30 fT/sqrt(Hz); p2p numerator
